title: PlayStation Audio CD Myth

scenes.text: The original PlayStation could only play game discs, not music CDs
scenes.query2: PlayStation 1 game disc vs audio CD

scenes.text: Many believe the PS1 lacked audio CD support entirely
scenes.label: No audio CD support

scenes.text: In reality the PS1 could read standard audio CDs and even play them as background music
scenes.label: Audio CD supported

scenes.text: Now you know the PS1 was a true multimedia player
scenes.label: Multimedia Fact

scenes.text: Follow if tech moves faster than you can keep up.

description: We bust the myth that the original PlayStation couldn't play music CDs. Discover the hidden multimedia side of this classic console. Follow for more tech revelations!
